title: IVG Smart Max Blueberry Raspberry Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Blueberry Raspberry delivers a smooth, berry-rich profile with a focus on juicy sweetness. The Blueberry note brings depth and softness, while the Raspberry adds brightness and tang, resulting in a clean, well-rounded fruit vape that’s easy to enjoy all day. Each pod pack contains a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, alongside a separate 10ml refill reservoir that connects directly to the pod. Once assembled, the system feeds e-liquid automatically to support up to 10,000 puffs per kit depending on your vaping habits. No refilling or coil swaps required. Featuring mesh coil technology for even heating and enhanced flavour, this pod is designed exclusively for the IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
